spec_issues: YAML combinational_behavior describes output 'act_count', but RTL does not clearly drive it with assign/always_comb/always @(*).

design_intent.purpose:
tFAW_ok is purely combinational (always_comb):
  if (act_count < 4):
    tFAW_ok = 1'b1
  else:
    tFAW_ok = ((cycle_counter - act_timestamps[3]) >= 30)
act_count output is a direct connection to the internal act_count register. On every rising clock edge:
  1. cycle_counter increments unconditionally (wraps 255->0).
  2. If act_valid is high:
     a. Shift timestamps: [3]<=[2], [2]<=[1], [1]<=[0], [0]<=cycle_counter.
     b. If act_count < 4: act_count <= act_count + 1.
        (When act_count == 4, it stays at 4; oldest entry silently overwritten.)
On synchronous reset (rst_n low):
  cycle_counter    <= 0
  act_timestamps[0] <= 0
  act_timestamps[1] <= 0
  act_timestamps[2] <= 0
  act_timestamps[3] <= 0
  act_count        <= 0

yaml_ports.name: act_valid
yaml_ports.description: Asserted for exactly one cycle when an ACTIVATE command is issued

yaml_ports.name: tFAW_ok
yaml_ports.description: Combinational output. High when the tFAW window constraint allows another ACTIVATE to be issued this cycle. Must be driven by always_comb, not always_ff.

yaml_ports.name: act_count
yaml_ports.description: Number of ACTIVATE commands currently tracked inside the rolling window (0 to 4). Saturates at 4; never exceeds 4.

correctness_criteria: tFAW_ok must be 1 when act_count < 4, regardless of timestamp values
tFAW_ok must be 0 when act_count == 4 AND (cycle_counter - act_timestamps[3]) < 30
tFAW_ok must be 1 when act_count == 4 AND (cycle_counter - act_timestamps[3]) >= 30
cycle_counter must be exactly 8 bits wide
all 4 timestamp registers must be reset to 0 on synchronous reset
tFAW_ok must not be registered — it must be combinational
act_timestamps[0] must always hold the most recently captured timestamp
act_timestamps[3] must always hold the oldest captured timestamp

act_count.description: Counts how many valid timestamp entries are present (0 to 4). Increments on act_valid while act_count < 4. Saturates at 4. Reset value: 0.

act_timestamps.description: Shift register of cycle_counter values captured at the moment each ACTIVATE was issued. Index [0] holds the most recent activation; index [3] holds the oldest. On each act_valid pulse the register shifts: [3]<=[2], [2]<=[1], [1]<=[0], [0]<=cycle_counter. All four registers reset to 0.

cycle_counter.description: Free-running counter. Increments by 1 on every rising clock edge. Wraps at 255 back to 0. Must be 8 bits wide — an 8-bit counter cannot wrap within a single tFAW window (max 30 cycles). Reset value: 0.

behavior.sequential_behavior:
On every rising clock edge:
  1. cycle_counter increments unconditionally (wraps 255->0).
  2. If act_valid is high:
     a. Shift timestamps: [3]<=[2], [2]<=[1], [1]<=[0], [0]<=cycle_counter.
     b. If act_count < 4: act_count <= act_count + 1.
        (When act_count == 4, it stays at 4; oldest entry silently overwritten.)
On synchronous reset (rst_n low):
  cycle_counter    <= 0
  act_timestamps[0] <= 0
  act_timestamps[1] <= 0
  act_timestamps[2] <= 0
  act_timestamps[3] <= 0
  act_count        <= 0
